decisions.reason: The ACE3 distributed ALCMS control unit was launched only in 2018 as a flagship 'new industry standard' with strong commitment, airfield lighting is the firm's core business with long procurement cycles, and its value is still uncertain, so the low-cost option should stay open.

The air situation display is only a year old in a market with long airport and ATC sales cycles, so too little evidence exists to judge its value, and as a software-centric product that complements the firm's airside portfolio it costs little to keep on the market.
